description: This file defines the 'Event' class in the Opencart System Engine namespace. It handles registration, triggering, unregistering, and clearing of event handlers within the OpenCart framework, facilitating event-driven architecture for the system.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents an event dispatcher with methods to register, trigger, unregister, and clear event handlers using triggers and actions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the Event object with a registry instance.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new event trigger with its associated action and priority.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Triggers all actions associated with a given event, matching trigger patterns.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Removes specific event trigger-action pairs associated with a route.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all event handlers for a specified trigger.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Stores registered event triggers, actions, and priorities.
